name: gizza-ai/extract-audio-from-video
summary: Extract the audio track from a video as MP3 or WAV.

tool.description: Extract the audio track from a video file as MP3 (lossy) or WAV (lossless). Set format='mp3' (default) or 'wav', and optionally bitrate (kbps, 32-320, default 192, mp3 only). Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

format.description: Output audio format: mp3 (lossy) or wav (lossless). Default mp3.

bitrate.description: MP3 bitrate in kbps (32-320, default 192). Ignored for lossless wav.
